journey_followup.source_state: Uncommitted private journey-map follow-up, not deployed/published.
journey_followup.method: Actual production React UI, real journey API/settings/context queries and isolated SQLite. Backend observe function seeds a fabricated series of location samples. Public CCP ESI system names/coordinates are visual references. Screenshots captured via in-app browser without repainting.
journey_followup.data: Synthetic linked characters and scopes, observed visits, holdings and killmails. No live character locations, account data, private ESI requests, OAuth consent or game actions.
journey_followup.validation: Browser verified distinct character histories, opt-in/pause persistence, playback advancing to the end, scrubbing, map selection loading correct context, UTC times, responsive map sizing and no document overflow; console errors empty. Backend scope/privacy/sampler/context/migration regressions, replay tests and production build pass.
journey_followup.limitations: Preview sampler is not running against live ESI; opt-in capture shows waiting state after a synthetic settings write. Real OAuth and live collection were not exercised. Context screenshot predates final map sizing-only polish; its displayed data and controls are unchanged. Asset markers are current stock during replay, not historical inventory.
